summary.text: Kurtis Gregory, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 21, which includes Cooper, Howard, Lafayette, Ray, Saline and part of Clay counties; he took the oath of office on January 8, 2025.
He served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2020 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Gregory was born in Blackburn, Missouri, graduated from Santa Fe R-10 High School in Alma, and earned a bachelor's and a master's degree in general agriculture from the University of Missouri.
He played football at the University of Missouri from 2006 to 2009, was team captain in 2009, and had a short stint in the NFL with the Carolina Panthers.
He owns a farm with his wife, Kella, and his parents, raising corn and soybeans on 900 acres and custom feeding 2,400 pigs.
He has served on the board of directors for Missouri Corn Growers.
His Senate biography says he has been a national pioneer in name, image and likeness legislation.
He lives in Marshall with his wife and three children.
